title: Boy Wading in Ocean Waves with Swimmers, 1956 Summer Beach Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-century snapshot capturing a lively ocean beach scene in August 1956. In the foreground, a young boy wearing patterned swim trunks wades through the rolling surf while gesturing towards the camera. Numerous other swimmers, children on inflatable mats and surfboards, and waders are scattered throughout the breaking waves, with a motorboat visible cruising in the background against the open horizon. The photograph features decorative deckled borders and a stamped front margin reading 'AUG 56'.
